title: Local quotient action on a square-zero ideal
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], B and C sheaves of commutative O_X-algebras [def-weil-pbc-ringed-space-algebra-module], p:B -> C an algebra morphism, and i:I -> B an O_X-module map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] forming a short exact sequence 0 -> I -> B -> C -> 0 [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]. Suppose products of any two kernel sections of p are zero. Then for every open U there is a unital ring homomorphism sigma_U:C(U) -> End_{O_X(U)}(I(U)), such that i(sigma_U(p(b))(x)) = b*i(x). These actions commute with restriction: res(sigma_U(f)(x)) = sigma_V(res(f))(res(x)) for every inclusion V subset U.

proof.text: Apply square_zero_glued_linear_operators to obtain linear endomorphisms α_U(f), the lift formula and restriction compatibility. The operator construction itself uses the unique-scalar-section gluing theorem.
Evaluation sends the mono i to an injective section map. The lift formula at b=0 and b=1 proves the zero and unit laws.

Use module_exactness_local_lifting twice to cover each open by opens admitting lifts b and c of f and g. Restriction compatibility reduces addition and multiplication of operators to these local sections. Apply the injective i, then the lift formula for b+c and b*c; distributivity and associativity prove both laws. Sheaf separatedness descends these equalities to U. Package the operators as ring homomorphisms, retaining the lift formula and restriction compatibility.

theorem square_zero_quotient_local_action (X : Scheme.{u})
    (B C : X.CommAlgebraSheaf) (p : B ⟶ C)
    (I : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (i : I ⟶ commAlgebraSheafModule X.sheaf B)
    (hw : i ≫ (commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p = 0)
    (hS : (ShortComplex.mk i ((commAlgebraSheafModuleFunctor X.sheaf).map p) hw).ShortExact)
    (hsq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (x y : B.right.obj.obj (op U)),
      p.right.hom.app (op U) x = 0 → p.right.hom.app (op U) y = 0 → x * y = 0) :
    ∃ (σ : ∀ U : X.Opens, C.right.obj.obj (op U) →+*
        Module.End ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op U)) (I.val.obj (op U))),
      (∀ (U : X.Opens) (b : B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        @id (B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (i.val.app (op U) (σ U (p.right.hom.app (op U) b) x)) =
          b * @id (B.right.obj.obj (op U)) (i.val.app (op U) x)) ∧
      (∀ (U V : X.Opens) (j : V ⟶ U) (f : C.right.obj.obj (op U)) (x : I.val.obj (op U)),
        I.val.map j.op (σ U f x) = σ V (C.right.obj.map j.op f) (I.val.map j.op x))
